evals.prompt: Create a Dinox saved view named Active Projects using my Status property and sort it by Priority.
evals.expected_output: The agent discovers field semantics and option IDs, constructs canonical version 1 JSON, dry-runs the create, and performs only the matching authorized write.
assertions: Runs `dino view fields --sync-timeout 20000 --format json` before composing property references.
Uses the stable Status option ID rather than its display label.
Passes canonical filter/config JSON through secure temporary files and dry-runs creation first.

evals.prompt: Use my saved view called Reading Queue and return every matching note.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the view ID, queries it with bounded JSON pagination, and follows nextOffset until hasMore is false before claiming completeness.
assertions: Finds the target with `dino view list` or an already-known exact ID.
Uses `dino view query <id>` with bounded limit/offset and JSON output.
Checks freshness and pagination before claiming every note was returned.

evals.prompt: The agent timed out updating my Priority view. Do not duplicate or overwrite blindly; determine whether it succeeded.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats the update outcome as unknown and verifies the existing definition before deciding whether any retry is needed.
assertions: Does not infer that the timed-out write failed.
Uses `dino view get <id> --sync-timeout 20000 --format json` or catalog lookup to verify the postcondition.
Retries only if the current definition does not match the requested update.
